objective: Improve all eight merchant dashboard pages with shared navigation/store state and reliable daily workflows
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard overview shows accurate and clearly labeled real metrics and actionable store information
Mobile navigation makes page content immediately usable and has accessible controls
Real store URLs and publication status stay correct across dashboard navigation
Loading and request failures are visible and recoverable
Targeted browser regressions, production build and local walkthrough pass
Orders, catalog, categories, themes, domains, billing and settings have recoverable request failures and usable mobile layouts
Settings save and publication changes update shared shop identity; order detail and permitted status actions work
non_goals: Unrequested features across every dashboard page
